content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Macon

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background, then gather transcripts and project records. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify you meet the baseline before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions from anywhere—no commute needed. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world scenarios and exam-aligned content over a structured schedule. You'll earn all required contact hours in one cohort.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, submit your formal PMP application to PMI with proof of education and experience. Pay the associated examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process and answer administrative questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our team remains available for last-minute clarifications and study strategies before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew. Pursue advanced training, conference attendance, volunteer leadership, or published work in project management. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to keep your credential active and your skills current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
